name: scheme-test
description: Tests for the scheme/ sub-app. Never shipped. The browser-driven half needs a server at http://localhost:8888 (python3 -m http.server 8888 from the repo root); BASE= overrides it. Nothing under render/ or report/ opens a browser: tools/walk.mjs opens each card once and they assert over what it wrote. SCHEME_IDS=<id>[,<id>] narrows that walk to those cards for a single-card review (seconds against minutes) and turns the catalog floors and censuses OFF, announcing itself as a SUBSET: the gate is the unfiltered run.
//walk: EVERY browser-driven file asserts over tools/walk.mjs, which opens each card ONCE and takes every reading. It is a PIPELINE STAGE and not a cache: test, test:render and report each take it first, every time, so no assertion can read a walk of a tree that has since changed. `npm run all` takes it once for both suites, which is what to run when you want the gate and the report together. Before this, twelve files drove a Chromium each and re-opened all 123 cards: 137 of the suite's 265 seconds went on re-opening cards another process had open a moment earlier.
//: Globs, not directories. On Node 22.15.1 `node --test unit/ render/` tries to LOAD each directory as a module and fails with MODULE_NOT_FOUND before running anything, and a glob that matches nothing exits 0, which is what keeps unit/ and report/ green while they are still empty.
//concurrency: MEASURED 2026-09-01 on this 4-core box, quiet: render at --test-concurrency 1/2/3/4 = 181.2/137.6/132.4/127.7s. The default is availableParallelism()-1 = 3, and pinning 4 buys 3.5% on a quiet machine while making a loaded one worse: nine of these files each hold a Chromium, and the suite is memory-bound before it is CPU-bound. So render is left on the default deliberately. test:unit is pinned to 4 because those files hold no browser: 4.0s at 1, 1.8s at 4.
//selftest: NOT part of the gate and never run by it. `tools/mutate.mjs` breaks a real card one known defect at a time and requires the check CANON.md names for that rule to go red on it, on its named axis. It is the only thing in the tree that asks whether a CHECK works rather than whether a CARD does: a check that sees nothing and a check that finds nothing print the same thing, and R-08a is the case where that difference had been read the wrong way for weeks. Needs the server, since two of its five mutations run the render tier.
